elements.requirement: An employer must take reasonable steps to prevent sexual harassment of its employees in the course of their employment.
elements.quote: An employer (A) must take reasonable steps to prevent sexual harassment of employees of A in the course of their employment.

elements.requirement: For the purpose of subsection (1), sexual harassment means harassment of the kind described in section 26(2), namely unwanted conduct of a sexual nature.
elements.quote: “Sexual harassment” in subsection (1) means harassment of the kind described in section 26(2) (unwanted conduct of a sexual nature).

elements.requirement: A contravention of subsection (1), or a contravention of section 111 or 112 that relates to a contravention of subsection (1), is enforceable as an unlawful act under Part 1 of the Equality Act 2006.
elements.quote: A contravention of subsection (1) (or a contravention of section 111 or 112 that relates to a contravention of subsection (1)) is enforceable as an unlawful act under Part 1 of the Equality Act 2006

elements.requirement: By virtue of section 120(8) and (9), a contravention of subsection (1) (or an associated contravention of section 111 or 112) is enforceable only by the Commission under Part 1 of the Equality Act 2006 or by an employment tribunal in accordance with section 124A governing compensation uplift in employee sexual harassment cases.
elements.quote: is enforceable only by the Commission under that Part or by an employment tribunal in accordance with section 124A (compensation uplift in employee sexual harassment cases)
